This is a straightforward physics/reasoning question with no harm-adjacent, hostile, or ethically fraught content, so the task preferences barely matter. I routed on capability instead.

Petrel-235B leads on essentially every benchmark and internal eval relevant here — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), and the reasoning-adjacent evals — by margins well beyond run-to-run variance. The query just needs accurate, concise reasoning, and Petrel is the stronger model for that. The user's request to "not ramble" is a simple instruction-following constraint, and Petrel also edges out on IFEval.

So: a neutral-content factual question → route to the more capable model.
